flagged:
AI-Generated (146 words): Feeling it once is a long way from feeling it only when you're tripping, and that's still a long way from feeling it on a regular morning while the coffee brews.
That night can turn into a hook, too, if it becomes the bar and every morning since feels like a letdown. It's a bit like a honeymoon. Gorgeous, sure, but nobody's marriage is done on day three. And whatever you saw that night isn't proof it really happened, however vivid it was. The weeks after will tell you more. Are you a bit more honest? More protective of your little one, easier to count on?
And if your little one still can't take the love in? Hold off on going bigger, however tempting it is. Something's in the way, and getting to know it is your next job.
